pr_title: Don't auto-dismiss the warning dialog on launch
pr_body:
Apparently, `ShowWindow` also sends a `WM_MOVE`, which we then turn around and use to dismiss open dialogs. 

Closes #15170

Regressed in #13811

issue_context.title: Settings error/warning dialog seems to self-dismiss on startup
issue_context.body:
### Windows Terminal version

56d451ded7cf9ca64abc511740221b963c98ded3

### Windows build number

10.0.22621.1555

### Other Software

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce

1. Checkout the main branch at 56d451ded7cf9ca64abc511740221b963c98ded3
2. Make your settings file invalid
3. Start Terminal

### Expected Behavior

The settings error dialog should be displayed.

### Actual Behavior

The settings error dialog displays for a fraction of a second and then disappears. See video below - you can just see a glimpse of the dialog. This also happens if you've got warnings (which is how I found it originally). This didn't happen whilst I was developing #15082 (which was merged with main at 0105807be22571c8470fc3be6b660da64683528e) - as I tested the duplicate environment variables warning numerous times, so I'd guess this is caused by #15078.
